name: Brother Industries
summary: Headquartered in Nagoya, Japan, Brother Industries, Ltd. is a global enterprise founded in 1908, engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of communication and printing technologies. Its extensive market reach spans Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, Oceania, the Middle East, and Africa. The company's diverse operations are organized across six primary divisions. Its Printing & Solutions segment delivers a comprehensive array of inkjet and laser printers (both monochrome and color), fax machines, scanners, and electronic stationery such as labeling systems and mobile label printers. The Personal & Home division caters to consumers with home sewing and cutting machines, alongside various sewing and embroidery models, including those designed for commercial applications. For industrial needs, the Machinery segment provides industrial sewing machines, advanced machine tools, garment printers, and critical industrial components like reducers and gears. The Network & Contents division focuses on entertainment and support services, offering online karaoke systems, music devices, smartphone/tablet applications, healthcare support equipment, and digital content services, as well as managing karaoke establishments. Furthermore, the Domino segment specializes in coding, marking, and digital printing equipment. The remaining business interests, including real estate, are managed under the Others segment. Historically, the company began as Nippon Sewing Machine Manufacturing Co. before rebranding to Brother Industries, Ltd. in 1962.
